title: Image options hidden in theme edit screen
description: On the theme edit screen, the options to Delete Photo, Choose Photo, and Cancel are not visible after tapping on the image section.
steps: Tap the three-dot menu for any existing theme (e.g., 'Fifty Groups').
Tap on the image section of the theme.
Observe that the 'Delete Photo', 'Choose Photo', and 'Cancel' options are not displayed.
actual: After tapping the image section on the theme edit screen, the options to Delete Photo, Choose Photo, and Cancel are hidden and not accessible.
expected: After tapping the image section on the theme edit screen, the options to Delete Photo, Choose Photo, and Cancel should be displayed and functional.
